Hi Samantha — great to meet you on the call. Thanks for the thoughtful questions. Below is a concise vendor-intake checklist and next steps so your finance team can pick the most efficient path.

Quick answer on payment paths (short version):
- PO (net-30): our most common enterprise route — predictable invoicing and revenue recognition for you; needs a vendor setup ticket in our portal and a signed commercial order.
- Company card: works well for pilots or proof-of-concept (smaller spend) — faster activation, no vendor setup required.
- Marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP): offers consolidated billing via the marketplace vendor account; good when customers want self-service and marketplace credits. Can add a ~2-week onboarding if we need to link accounts.

Vendor intake checklist (what we need from Greenleaf):
1) Completed vendor packet (attached): Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (includes fields for legal name, tax ID, address, remittance, and preferred payment path).
2) W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) — attach to reply.
3) Banking details only if you want ACH (routing + account) — we accept ACH for PO payments; otherwise we'll invoice to the billing address.
4) Billing contact name + email + preferred PO format (PO number on invoice or via portal).
5) If marketplace is preferred: indicate provider (AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace / GCP Marketplace) and whether you want consolidated billing.

Next steps / timeline: 
- If you want PO: Finance needs the completed packet + W-9. Once received, we open a vendor ticket with our Finance Ops team; typical turnaround 7–10 business days for internal approvals.
- If card: we can start pilot billing within 48 hours after you confirm card.
- If marketplace: we'll open a marketplace enablement case; typically 10–14 business days depending on third-party verification.

I've attached our vendor packet to this email to make it easy. If you can route the completed packet + a W-9 back to me, I'll kick off the vendor ticket with Finance Ops and loop Ben (Finance Ops) and Monica (Commercial CS) to coordinate the onboarding and billing setup.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if procurement wants to review the vendor packet live.

Best,
Irene Choi
